verdicts.why: The selected test proves that two differently valued guards on the same source guard port may share one input, while unguarded edges and guards on different ports or sources are detected as fan-in. It does not assert the complete A05-3 biconditional, notably the same-port/same-value case, nor A05-4 universally for every port; it exercises only the concrete save.x input.
